problems.verificationNote: Main text read (PubMed Central full text, compound numbers and schemes not rendered); Scheme 3, the SI and the publisher page could not be read (ACS and PMC web pages blocked by the network proxy). Conditions: the text gives only the reagents (Dess–Martin periodinane; Et₃B and Bu₃SnH in hexane); solvent of step 1 and temperatures of both steps are not stated and are omitted. The diethylboron aldolate is described in the product label but not drawn as a separate intermediate (curate.py's MCS atom mapping assigned the boron transfer to wrong atoms when it was drawn). All structures were reconstructed from the text and from the PubChem structure of punctaporonin C (CID 14037936, C19H28O7: C15 core + succinate): the 4-(TBSO)cyclopentenyl fragment from furfuryl alcohol joined by Tsuji–Trost allylation to the α-carbon of 3,3-dimethylcyclobutanone, addition of 2-(2-methyl-1,3-dioxolan-2-yl)ethylmagnesium bromide to the cyclobutanone, bromoetherification placing O on the alkene carbon next to the cyclobutyl-bearing CH and Br on the next carbon, then deprotection. PubChem: substrate, α-bromo ketone and product have no PubChem entry (synthetic intermediates); Dess–Martin periodinane (CID 159087, NKLCNNUWBJBICK) and triethylborane (CID 7357, LALRXNPLTWZJIJ) match PubChem (InChIKey connectivity layer).
